title: Perfection!
text: Perfection!. Love it. I have Myasthenia Gravis and it can be difficult for me to scoop ice cream. This scoop made it so easy.

product_metadata.title: SUKRAGRAHA Anti Frost Never Bend Aluminium Ice Cream Scoop (Silver)
features: Package Includes: 1 X Aluminum Ice-cream Scoop
The heat from your hand will be absorbed by the scoop and it glides through hard ice-cream.
Do not place in dishwasher or expose to temperatures over 140 degrees Fahrenheit / 60 C
description: Enjoy your ice-cream with this easy to use ice-cream scoop. The heat from your hand will be absorbed by the scoop and it glides through hard ice-cream.
